opportunities.name: Resy special-event ticket reservation
opportunities.description: Open a Resy city's Special Events list, pick an event, choose a ticket count and time slot, and start the reservation.
steps: Open the Resy homepage for the target city (the city selector shows the current city).
Scroll to 'Special Events & Experiences' and click the event tile for the target event.
On the event page, open the ticket-count dropdown and choose the number of tickets.
Click 'Book Now' on the desired ticket type, or click the time-slot button for the target time.
In the 'Complete Your Reservation' dialog, review the details and click 'Reserve Now' (or log in if prompted).
parameters: ticket type (e.g. Centurion / Platinum Member access, or a time slot)

instances.values: Miami; American Express Presents CARBONE BEACH, Thu May 4 2023 7:30 PM; 2 then 3 tickets; Centurion Member Access, Book Now. Interleaved with an MBTA ferry lookup.
Atlanta; Aria HAPPY HOUR BURGER, Thu Apr 13 2023 5:00 PM; 2 then 1 ticket; 5:00 PM time slot. Interleaved with REI browsing.

opportunities.name: NPS find a park by state
opportunities.description: Use the National Park Service homepage 'Find a Park' state dropdown to open the list of parks in a chosen state.
steps: Open the National Park Service homepage.
Click the 'By State...' dropdown under 'Find a Park'.
Scroll the dropdown list and click the target state.
Review the resulting list of parks or heritage sites for that state.

instances.values: Alaska (dropdown opened at 3.8s, Alaska clicked at 9.6s; Alaska park list seen at 27.6s).
Florida (dropdown opened at 13.6s; Florida list seen at 24.0s with Dry Tortugas, Everglades, De Soto).
California (dropdown opened at 582.5s, California clicked at 587.6s; California list seen at 594.1s).

opportunities.name: Megabus track a bus by service number
opportunities.description: Open Megabus's 'Check my bus' tracker, switch to the Service Number tab, enter a service number, and submit to see live bus status.
steps: Open megabus.com and click 'Check my bus' in the top navigation.
Click the 'Service Number' tab on the tracker page.
Click the 'Search by Service Number' field and type the service number (it may show an autocomplete suggestion; select it).
Click 'Find my bus'.

instances.values: Service-number search opened; the value typed was not captured in the frames.
Service number SE4; autocomplete suggestion picked, then 'Find my bus' clicked.

opportunities.name: Amazon Kindle book search with sort and add-to-list
opportunities.description: Search Amazon's Kindle Store for a topic, optionally sort or filter the results, then open a book and add it to a list.
steps: Open amazon.com and switch the search department to 'Kindle Store' (or 'Kindle eBooks').
Click the search box, type the search terms, and press the search button.
Optionally set 'Sort by' (e.g. Publication Date) and tick filters such as Language.
Click the target book title to open its product page.
Click 'Add to List', enter a list name, and click 'Create List'.

instances.values: Search 'roman empire history' in Kindle Store; English language filter ticked.
Search 'roman empire history' in Kindle eBooks; sort by Publication Date; opened 'Records of the Medieval Sword'; Add to List named 'Shopping List'.

opportunities.name: Amex Careers job search with filters
opportunities.description: Search American Express careers for a keyword, set skill and work-location filters, and open a matching job posting.
steps: Open the Amex careers search page and enter a keyword in the search box (e.g. 'resy').
Click 'Filters' and select the skill tags (e.g. Software Development) and work-location chips (e.g. Hybrid).
Click 'Go' to apply the search.
Click the target job title in the results list and then 'Apply Now' if needed.

instances.values: Keyword 'resy'; Filters opened; skill Software Development chosen; View All Open Positions path via Resy careers link.
Keyword 'resy'; Work Location Hybrid and Manager filters; opened Senior iOS Engineer - Resy and clicked Apply Now.
